claims.claim: Quanta's June 30, 2026 10-Q reports remaining performance obligations of $33.55B and total backlog of $53.44B, up 41.2% and 21.5% respectively from Dec. 31, 2025; it also states MSA estimates are part of backlog and customers generally are not committed to specific MSA volumes, with most contracts terminable on short notice.

factors.name: backlog growth with contract-quality caveat
factors.basis: Large RPO/backlog growth supports demand visibility, while MSA/non-fixed-price components make headline backlog less firm than fully contracted obligations.

risks.risk: Backlog includes estimated MSA orders/renewals and non-fixed-price contracts; many customer contracts can be terminated on short notice, limiting the certainty implied by headline backlog.

causalEdges.mechanism: customer infrastructure programs generate awarded work and performance obligations
causalEdges.falsifier: RPO/backlog decline materially despite continued end-market capital programs

unknowns.unknown: The packet still requires root-owner numeric underwriting and confidence construction; this assist does not assign a score.

claims.claim: For the six months ended June 30, 2026, Quanta reported $1.49B of operating cash flow, up 176% year over year; it used $956.9M of cash for acquisitions/investments, had $2.77B of available credit commitments plus cash, and remained in compliance with credit covenants.

factors.name: cash generation and liquidity
factors.basis: Strong operating cash generation and available liquidity support execution of a capital-intensive growth and acquisition program.

risks.risk: Capital intensity and acquisition spending are substantial: six-month acquisition cash use was $930.3M and capex was $451.0M, while commercial paper outstanding was $448M at June 30.

causalEdges.from: higher operating income and working-capital conversion
causalEdges.to: operating cash flow and funding capacity
causalEdges.mechanism: cash generated from operations funds capex and strategic acquisitions alongside credit capacity
causalEdges.falsifier: cash conversion deteriorates materially while acquisition/capex commitments remain elevated

unknowns.unknown: No canonical leverage threshold or valuation conclusion is asserted by Scout.
